'''First Duros Division''' was a division within [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] composed of [[Duros/Legends|Duros]]. Agent [[Velloo]] was a member of the Division.<ref name="TOR" />
